name: French Toast
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 2, grillardin 2, line cook 2, patissier 2

Flavor Profiles texture, sweet
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, spicy, sweet, temperature, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1d6

DESCRIPTION

French toast is made when stale bread is soaked in egg beaten with milk or water and grilled or fried and topped with fruit and syrup. It also can be served as a salty dish with different toppings.

When consumed, french toast grants a +2 enhancement bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the bonus and serving size by +1 each, to a maximum of +1 per level.

Additional salty, temperature, and umami ingredients grant the bonus on Handle Animal and Intimidate checks for the duration instead.
